content.text: Two people replied to the newsletter saying the opt-out link in it is broken. Start with the logs.

Right, here is what I actually want to know: how long is an unsubscribe token supposed to stay valid after we mint it, and is that expiry measured from when the email was generated or from when somebody opened it? Because the newsletter is written on a Monday and plenty of people do not open it until Friday, and if the token expiry is anchored to generation time then a five day old unsubscribe link is dead on arrival for a big chunk of the list.

Anchored to generation, and the window is 72 hours. signUnsubscribe() stamps iat at render time and verify() rejects anything older, so a Friday reader of a Monday send gets a 410. The fix is to stop expiring these at all: an unsubscribe link is a permanent right, not a session.
Unsubscribe tokens no longer carry an expiry; the signature alone gates them. The two reported addresses opt out cleanly now.
